title: Crane detail audit
slide_intent: Make small shape decisions explicit because recognition and reproduction depend on details within a familiar silhouette.
strategic_value: Named areas of the crane can focus a refresh on controlled adjustments rather than arbitrary redrawing.
demonstration: Cyan circles and leaders identify the ring, beak, neck, wing and tail areas of a large black crane.
practical_value: Use labeled regions to compare proposed mark refinements systematically.

content_islands.name: Mark
content_islands.spec: Center the large black crane and ring.

content_islands.name: Detail annotations
content_islands.spec: Arrange cyan circles and gray labels around the features they identify.
